fields.summary_ko.0: AMZN's recent net income is inflated by mark-to-market gains on Anthropic stake, not actual cash earnings from AWS and retail operations, requiring caution in assessment.
fields.summary_ko.1: AWS execution and backlog conversion serve as near-term catalysts, while the long-term critical judgment point is whether annual $22B+ capital expenditure is sufficiently offset by AWS's high-margin cash generation, with Amazon Leo satellite network infrastructure expansion initiatives underway.
